novel_features.name: Stop evidence and unknowns
novel_features.description: Inspect source facts and permission or service unknowns for one station ID
novel_features.rationale: This uses GET /stations/views/{id} factual fields plus a clearly separated, attributed MLIT rest-guidance reference to compute a mechanical evidence/unknowns envelope with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Campervan planner; trip agent can inspect source evidence without merging tabs manually.

novel_features.name: Ordered station comparison
novel_features.description: Compare up to six ordered station IDs with source facts and per-ID failures
novel_features.rationale: This uses a bounded ordered set of GET /stations/views/{id} responses to compute aligned factual comparison rows with per-station provenance and missing/error states, with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Campervan planner; trip agent can inspect source evidence without merging tabs manually.

novel_features.name: Scoped straight-line nearby ranking
novel_features.description: Rank source stations by straight-line kilometers from required latitude/longitude, scoped by area and facilities
novel_features.rationale: This uses GET /stations/search/{prefectures}/{facilities}/{keyword} map coordinates to compute Haversine kilometers and stable-ID tie ordering over the observed candidate set, with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Campervan planner can inspect source evidence without merging tabs manually.

novel_features.name: Bounded station-linked notices
novel_features.description: Find notices explicitly linked to one station ID within page/detail scan limits
novel_features.rationale: This uses a bounded GET /notices index scan and its bounded notice-detail requests to join explicit /stations/views/{id} links,, to requested station IDs, with no external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Advisory researcher; trip agent can inspect source evidence without merging tabs manually.

novel_features.name: Offline observation diff
novel_features.description: Compare two saved snapshot files offline by stable station ID and factual fields, or use an explicit synthetic demo
novel_features.rationale: This uses two user-retained JSON observations emitted by snapshot --ids to compute deterministic field and station-membership differences, observation times, and provenance without network requests or external dependencies.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Trip agent; advisory researcher can inspect source evidence without merging tabs manually.

narrative.headline: Find and compare Japan roadside-station service stops with source evidence and explicit unknowns.
narrative.value_prop: Search the official Japanese directory by prefecture, source region, and facilities. Compare parking and published hours, rank nearby candidates, inspect bounded station notices, and compare saved observations without inferring camping permission.
narrative.auth_narrative: Authorized directory routes require no authentication. No accounts, cookies or bookings are used.

quickstart.comment: Check local command readiness without network.
Resolve official prefecture and facility vocabulary.
Find a bounded source-listed bath shortlist.
Inspect facts and unresolved overnight/current-service questions.

narrative.when_to_use: Use for Japan roadside-station service stops, source-listed parking/food/bath/EV facilities, bounded dated notices and explicit unknowns. Use nearby for straight-line scoped candidates, compare for an existing shortlist, and readiness for unresolved permissions/status.
anti_triggers: Driving routes or campervan clearance guarantees
Inferring overnight lodging/camping permission or live facility availability
